See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.

translations.web: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.
translations.bsb: Bless those who persecute you. Bless and do not curse.
translations.kjv: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
translations.asv: Bless them that persecute you; bless, and curse not.
